name: Neural Vertex Features for Global Illumination
aliases: Vertex Features for Neural Global Illumination
definition: A method that encodes spatial information and appearance directly at the vertices of a mesh to approximate outgoing radiance, reducing memory overhead compared to 3D-grid-based encoding by exploiting geometric priors.
summary: Neural Vertex Features for Global Illumination stores learnable feature vectors at mesh vertices to represent radiance, reducing memory usage by over five times compared to hash grids while avoiding grid artifacts.
